notes: §1985:X.4.5.3 SR1: 'The EXTERNAL clause may be specified only in file description entries ... or in record description entries in the Working-Storage Section', which §1985:X.4.3.3 SR2 narrows to Working-Storage entries 'whose level-number is 01'; the 2023 extension to level 1 type declarations does not exist at 85. The Residence row of ClausePlacementRules.Rules for EXTERNAL admits only Working-Storage at level 1 (plus type declarations), ScreenClausePlacement asks it of every written clause through ResidenceFault (COBOL2404), the FD and SD entry formats are closed lists (SD EXTERNAL COBOL1970), and at 85 the type-declaration arm is unreachable because TYPEDEF itself is COBOL0900. Probes at --std 85: (b) EXTERNAL on a Linkage 01 (the witness), on an FD record 01, on a Working-Storage 05 and on a 77 each COBOL2404, SD S1 EXTERNAL COBOL1970; (c) 01 TD EXTERNAL TYPEDEF refused with COBOL0900; legal: FD F1 IS EXTERNAL with a Working-Storage 01 EXTERNAL group holding an OCCURS DEPENDING table ran OK, and a report-file FD IS EXTERNAL (§1985:X.4.2 Format 3) plus a Working-Storage 01 W EXTERNAL shared with a contained program printed INNER ABCD and wrote the report line ABCD.

next.reason: 1985: "may be specified only in file description entries ... or in record description entries in the Working-Storage Section"; 2023: "only in file description entries, in level 1 data description entries in the working-storage section, and in level 1 type declarations". Same file description and working-storage placements, but 2023 adds level 1 type declarations as a permitted place for EXTERNAL, which 1985 does not allow.
